title: The Sun

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Sun
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: The Sun is a star. It is at the centre of our solar system. The Sun is a huge ball of hot gas. It gives us light and heat. Without the Sun, the Earth would be cold and empty of life.

The Sun is very big. It is about 109 times wider than the Earth. Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to come to the Earth. The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old. The Sun looks yellow from the ground, but its real colour is white.
